def problem_spec
-- function signature
(impl: List Int → Option Int × Option Int)
-- inputs
(lst: List Int) :=
-- spec
let spec (result: Option Int × Option Int) :=
  let (a, b) := result;
  (match a with
  | none => ¬(∃ i, i ∈ lst ∧ i < 0)
  | some a => a < 0 ∧ a ∈ lst ∧ ∀ i, i ∈ lst ∧ i < 0 → i ≤ a) ∧
  (match b with
  | none => ¬(∃ i, i ∈ lst ∧ 0 < i)
  | some b => 0 < b ∧ b ∈ lst ∧ ∀ i, i ∈ lst ∧ 0 < i → b ≤ i)
-- program termination
∃ result, impl lst = result ∧
-- return value satisfies spec
spec result
